strategy.text: (1) ATTACK? Pelipper in rain will almost certainly attack: Hurricane (Flying STAB, 100% acc in rain), Scald, or Hydro Pump (rain-boosted 1.5x Water). I expect a Water move or Hurricane since my Weezing-Galar walls it poorly and it wants chip on the switch-in. Confidence: high that it attacks rather than switches (it just came in to set rain and threaten). (2) SWITCH? Unlikely to switch — it's already in position to abuse rain; Claydol would be its only revealed switch and it forfeits the rain advantage. (3) THEIR READ OF ME: it knows only Weezing-Galar (Strange Steam missed, Poison/Fairy). It does not know my Electric attackers, so a Water/Hurricane move aimed at chipping or KOing Weezing is its natural line — good for my switch-in. (4) MY OPTIONS & SWITCH COST: Rotom-Heat (Scarf Thunderbolt, 4x) guarantees the outspeed AND the OHKO but is ELECTRIC/FIRE = 2x weak to Water; switching in vs Scald (99-118%, possible OHKO) or Hydro Pump (guaranteed OHKO) is far too risky. Toxtricity (Emel/Fire... Electric/Poison) takes Water NEUTRALLY and Flying RESISTED (0.5x), survives EVERYTHING Pelipper has (Hurricane 27-32%, Scald 59-70%, Hydro Pump 81-96% — survives all). Its Wild Charge (Electric, 4x) is a guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper even with Life Orb. Cost: it eats one hit on switch-in (min 4% HP). I am NOT behind — this wins the exchange cleanly. (5) MOST LIKELY ACTION + MY RESPONSE: Pelipper uses Scald/Hydro Pump/Hurricane into my switch; Toxtricity survives, then next turn Wild Charge OHKOs Pelipper (4x). Falsifier: if Pelipper switches out or reveals a Ground move (unlikely). (6) SEQUENCE: I switch Toxtricity in (eats one hit), next turn Toxtricity Wild Charge OHKOs Pelipper (recoil + Life Orb may KO Toxtricity if it ate Hydro Pump, but Pelipper dies regardless = favorable trade).
